prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Full Stack Developer - Chat GPT API Integration to Hubspot
We are seeking a full stack developer with experience in integrating Open AI's API into CRM platforms such as Hubspot. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of language based models, machine learning, and workflow requests. As a member of our team, you will be responsible for developing and implementing the integration of the API into our existing CRM system to improve the efficiency and productivity of our sales team. Key Responsibilities: Develop and implement the integration of the API into our existing CRM system (Hubspot) Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales and IT, to understand requirements and develop solutions that meet business needs Troubleshoot and debug issues as they arise Monitor and optimize performance of the integrated system Stay up-to-date with new developments and best practices in the field Qualifications: 2+ years of experience in full stack development with a focus on API integration Strong understanding of Open AI API and its capabilities Experience with Hubspot or other CRM platforms Experience in developing and deploying machine learning models Strong problem solving and analytical skills Experience with Agile development methodologies
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need a full stack developer who can integrate OpenAI’s API into HubSpot to improve sales-team efficiency and keep the system reliable, fast, and aligned with workflow needs.  

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. I can help design and implement the API integration, support workflow-based requirements, troubleshoot issues, and optimize performance as the system grows. I’m comfortable working across technical and business teams to turn requirements into practical solutions, and I’m used to approaching problems with a strong analytical mindset.  

Could you share which HubSpot workflows or sales tasks you want the ChatGPT integration to support first?
